description: Encodes a signal as an eight-bit number and puts each bit on its own gate output

params.text: Scales the input before encoding, -1 to +1, and starts at 0.2 so that a 5V signal fills the range
Adds an offset of -5V to 5V to the scaled input, shifting which bits come on
Cycles the encoder: Uni. 8 encodes positive voltages with bit 8 most significant, Bi. Off. shifts a bipolar signal up first, Bi. Sig. gives the sign on bit 8 and makes bit 7 most significant
Cycles the rectifier ahead of the encoder: None passes the signal, Half replaces negative voltages with 0V, Full takes the absolute value

inputs.text: A rising gate here updates the bits; with nothing patched they are recalculated every sample

outputs.text: The state of that bit, 10V when it is 1 and 0V when it is 0; bit 1 is the least significant
All eight bits on one polyphonic cable, bit 1 on channel 1

inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
